A company runs an application on Amazon EC2 instances that uses an Amazon Aurora database. The EC2 instances connect with a user name and password stored locally in a file. The company changes the user name and password monthly and wants to minimize credential management overhead. Which solution meets these requirements?
Store the credentials as a secret in AWS Secrets Manager. Assign IAM permissions to the secret. Reconfigure the application to retrieve it. Enable secret rotation on a monthly schedule.
... to a parameter. Reconfigure the application to access that parameter. [The beginning of this option is missing and replaced by repeated question text in the source.]
Create an Amazon S3 bucket for objects encrypted with an AWS KMS key. Move the credentials file to the bucket. Update the application to retrieve the credentials file from the bucket.
Create an encrypted Amazon EBS volume for each EC2 instance and attach it to the instance. Move the credentials file to the new volume. Point the application to the encrypted volume.

A company deploys a non-production Amazon EC2 instance in a private subnet using an Amazon Linux AMI. A group of developers must connect remotely through SSH without exposing the instance to the internet. Developers must be able to connect through the AWS Management Console. Which solution meets these requirements?

Create a VPC endpoint for AWS Systems Manager in the same subnet as the EC2 instance. Allow inbound access from the endpoint security group to the EC2 instance security group on port 22. Create an IAM role for the instance and attach the AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore policy.

Create an EC2 Instance Connect Endpoint in the same subnet as the EC2 instance. Attach a security group to the endpoint that allows inbound connections on port 443. Assign the AmazonEC2InstanceConnect IAM managed policy to the developers' group.

Create an EC2 Instance Connect Endpoint in the same subnet as the EC2 instance. Attach a security group to the endpoint that allows inbound connections on port 22. Assign the AmazonEC2InstanceConnect IAM managed policy to the developers' group.

Create a VPC endpoint for AWS Systems Manager in the same subnet as the EC2 instance. Allow inbound access from the endpoint security group to the EC2 instance security group on port 22. Create an IAM role for the instance and attach the AmazonSSMReadOnlyAccess policy.

A company's website runs on Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). An Amazon CloudFront distribution is in front of the ALB. Users report performance problems. A solutions architect discovers that the website is receiving high-rate requests from a range of source IP addresses through CloudFront. What should the solutions architect do?
Use AWS Shield to configure a deny rule with an IP match condition containing the unwanted request source IP addresses.
Use Auto Scaling and increase the maximum instance count to absorb unwanted requests.
Use Amazon VPC network ACLs to configure an inbound deny rule for each unwanted source IP address's CIDR block.
Use AWS WAF to configure a rate-based rule in a web ACL on the CloudFront distribution, with a rate limit below that of the unwanted requesters.

A company uses an Active Directory-based identity service that supports SAML 2.0. The company wants to use its existing authentication solution to access the AWS Management Console. A solutions architect must configure federated authentication. Which solution meets these requirements?
Create a new trust provider using AWS Verified Access. Connect the existing Active Directory IdP service to a Verified Access endpoint.
Create an identity pool using Amazon Cognito. Add the existing Active Directory IdP to the user pool. Upload the SAML metadata.

Use AWS Amplify Auth to configure a custom authentication backend. Set up an Amazon EC2 instance running a Node.js application that connects AWS IAM Identity Center to on-premises Active Directory through LDAP.
Configure AWS IAM Identity Center to use an external IdP. Supply the SAML metadata from the identity provider.

A company plans to deploy a business-critical application in the AWS Cloud. The application requires durable storage with consistent performance and low latency. Which storage type should a solutions architect recommend?
Instance store volumes
An Amazon ElastiCache (Memcached) cluster
Provisioned IOPS SSD Amazon EBS volumes
Throughput Optimized HDD Amazon EBS volumes

A financial company processes transactions from multiple payment providers through its AWS infrastructure. The company needs a system that sends high-value transactions to a fraud detection service, routes failed transactions to a retry queue, copies international transactions to a compliance monitoring system, and archives all transactions for auditing. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
Configure Amazon EventBridge input transformers to modify event structures before basic filtering on event types.
Create a separate Amazon EventBridge event bus for each payment provider. Use context-based routing with event patterns that match the conditions.
Use Amazon EventBridge Pipes to filter events and route them to different target systems.
Create an Amazon EventBridge event bus with multiple rules. Configure each rule to use event pattern matching for the specified conditions.

A company runs a MySQL database on AWS and needs a disaster recovery (DR) plan. The company wants regular database backups and must retain copies in its on-premises DR data center so that the database can be restored locally if necessary. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
Create individual RDS DB snapshots and export them to Amazon S3. Use the aws s3 sync command to synchronize the snapshots to the on-premises DR data center.
Configure AWS Backup to run and manage RDS backups. Copy the backups to a vault in the on-premises DR data center.
Use mysqldump to export the database, store the export in Amazon S3, and synchronize it to the on-premises DR data center daily.
Create individual RDS DB snapshots and export them to Amazon S3. Use AWS DataSync to transfer the snapshots to the on-premises DR data center.

A company runs multiple applications on Amazon EC2 instances in a single VPC. The applications need to encrypt and decrypt specific data items in records exchanged between them. Which solution meets this requirement?
Encrypt the Amazon EBS storage associated with each application's EC2 instances.
Use AWS KMS AWS owned symmetric keys.
Use AWS KMS customer managed symmetric keys.
Use a virtual private gateway to encrypt traffic between applications.

A company manages millions of documents in hundreds of Amazon S3 buckets across multiple AWS Regions. The company must determine whether the buckets contain personally identifiable information (PII). Which solution meets this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?
Use Amazon Detective to detect PII in the S3 buckets.
Use AWS Trusted Advisor to generate PII notifications.
Use Amazon Macie to detect PII in the S3 buckets.
Use an AWS Lambda function to review every file in the S3 buckets for PII.

A company is deploying an application that processes streaming data in near real time. The company plans to use Amazon EC2 instances for the workload. The network architecture must be configurable to provide the lowest latency between nodes. Which networking solution meets these requirements?
Place the EC2 instances in multiple VPCs and configure VPC peering.
Attach an Elastic Fabric Adapter (EFA) to each EC2 instance.
Run the EC2 instances in a spread placement group.
Use Amazon EBS-optimized instance types.

A company uses an Amazon CloudFront distribution to serve content pages for its website. The company must ensure that customers use TLS certificates when accessing the website. It wants to automate certificate creation and renewal. Which solution meets these requirements MOST operationally efficiently?
Use a CloudFront security policy to create the certificates.
Use CloudFront origin access control (OAC) to create the certificates.
Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to create the certificates. Use DNS validation for the domain name.
Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to create the certificates. Use email validation for the domain name.

A solutions architect has AWS Lambda functions that need access to the company's internal data science libraries and reference data. Separate teams manage the libraries and data and must be able to update them and upload new data independently. The Lambda functions connect to the company's central VPC. Which solution gives the functions access to the libraries and data?

Attach Amazon EBS volumes to the Lambda functions using EBS Multi-Attach in the central VPC. Update the function execution roles to allow access to the volumes. Update the function code to reference files on the volumes.
Package the libraries and reference data in the Lambda /tmp directory. Update the function code to reference files in /tmp.
Create an Amazon EFS file system with mount targets in the central VPC. Configure the Lambda functions to mount it. Update the function execution roles to allow access to the file system.

Create an Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file system with mount targets in the central VPC. Configure the Lambda functions to mount it. Update the function execution roles to allow access to the file system.

A company runs several highly utilized Amazon RDS for Oracle On-Demand DB instances in a member account of an organization in AWS Organizations. The finance team has access to both the management account and member accounts and wants to optimize costs using AWS Trusted Advisor. Which combination of steps meets these requirements? (Choose two.)
Use Trusted Advisor recommendations in the management account.
Use Trusted Advisor recommendations in the member account running the RDS DB instances.
Review the Trusted Advisor Amazon RDS Reserved Instance Optimization check.
Review the Trusted Advisor Amazon RDS Idle DB Instances check.
Review the Trusted Advisor compute optimization checks. Cross-check the results with AWS Compute Optimizer.

A company uses a Microsoft SQL Server database connected to its application. The company wants to migrate to an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL database with minimal application code changes. Which combination of steps meets these requirements? (Choose two.)
Use AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) to rewrite SQL queries in the application.
Enable Babelfish on Aurora PostgreSQL to run the application's SQL queries.
Use AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) and AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to migrate the database schema and data.
Use Amazon RDS Proxy to connect the application to Aurora PostgreSQL.
Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to rewrite SQL queries in the application.

A company has an organization in AWS Organizations. It runs Amazon EC2 instances in four AWS accounts under the root organizational unit (OU): three non-production accounts and one production account. The company wants to prevent users in non-production accounts from launching certain EC2 instance sizes. It creates a service control policy (SCP) that denies launching the prohibited instance types. Which ways of deploying the SCP meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
Attach the SCP to the organization's root OU.
Attach the SCP to the three non-production member accounts.
Attach the SCP to the organization's management account.
Create an OU for the production account. Attach the SCP to the OU. Move the production member account into the new OU.
Create an OU for the required accounts. Attach the SCP to the OU. Move the non-production member accounts into the new OU.

A company runs an application as a task in an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster. The application needs read and write access to a specific set of Amazon S3 buckets. The buckets and ECS cluster are in the same AWS Region and account. The company must grant access according to the principle of least privilege. Which combination of solutions meets these requirements? (Choose two.)
Add a tag to each bucket. Create an IAM policy with a StringEquals condition matching the buckets' tags and values.
Create an IAM policy listing the full Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of each S3 bucket.
Attach the IAM policy to the instance role for the ECS task.
Create an IAM policy with a wildcard Amazon Resource Name (ARN) matching the combination of all S3 bucket names.
Attach the IAM policy to the ECS task role.

A company has a single AWS account with workloads in multiple VPCs in one AWS Region. It also has on-premises workloads connected to AWS through AWS Direct Connect. All EC2 instances in the VPCs must resolve DNS queries for internal.example.com through authoritative DNS servers in the on-premises data center. Communication between the VPCs and the on-premises network must remain private. All route tables, network ACLs, and security groups are correctly configured. Which combination of actions meets these requirements? (Choose three.)
Create an Amazon Route 53 Resolver inbound endpoint in every workload VPC.
Create an Amazon Route 53 Resolver outbound endpoint in one workload VPC.
Create an Amazon Route 53 Resolver rule of type Forward to forward internal.example.com queries to the on-premises DNS servers.
Create an Amazon Route 53 Resolver rule of type System configured to forward internal.example.com queries to the on-premises DNS servers.
Associate the Amazon Route 53 Resolver rule with all workload VPCs.
Associate the Amazon Route 53 Resolver rule with the workload VPC containing the new Route 53 endpoint.

A company stores sensitive user information in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company wants to provide secure access to the bucket from an application tier running on Amazon EC2 instances inside a VPC. Which combination of steps should a solutions architect take? (Choose two.)
Configure a gateway VPC endpoint for Amazon S3 in the VPC.
Create a bucket policy that makes objects in the S3 bucket public.
Create a bucket policy that restricts access to the application tier running in the VPC.
Create an IAM user with an S3 access policy and copy the IAM credentials to the EC2 instances.
Create a NAT instance and have the EC2 instances use it to access the S3 bucket.

A social media company lets users upload images to a website running on Amazon EC2 instances. During each upload request, the website resizes the image to a standard size and stores the resized image in Amazon S3. Users are experiencing slow uploads. The company needs to reduce application coupling and improve performance. A solutions architect must design the MOST operationally efficient upload workflow. Which combination of actions meets these requirements? (Choose two.)
Configure the application to upload images to S3 Glacier.
Configure the web servers to upload original images to Amazon S3.
Configure the application to upload images directly from each user's browser to Amazon S3 using presigned URLs.
Configure S3 event notifications to invoke an AWS Lambda function when an image is uploaded. Use the function to resize the image.
Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rule that invokes an AWS Lambda function on a schedule to resize uploaded images.

A company uses an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster. The company must use IAM roles for service accounts (IRSA) to give Kubernetes service accounts secure, fine-grained access to specific AWS resources. Which combination of solutions meets these requirements?
Create an IAM policy defining the required permissions and attach it directly to the EKS nodes' IAM role.
Implement network policies in the EKS cluster to prevent Kubernetes service accounts from accessing specific AWS services.
Modify the EKS cluster's IAM role to include permissions for each Kubernetes service account. Ensure a one-to-one mapping between IAM roles and Kubernetes roles.
Define IAM roles with the necessary permissions. Annotate Kubernetes service accounts with the IAM roles' Amazon Resource Names (ARNs).
Establish a trust relationship between the IAM role for a service account and the OpenID Connect (OIDC) identity provider.

A company hosts an application on AWS that lets users upload photos and stores them in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company wants to use Amazon CloudFront and a custom domain name to upload photo files to the S3 bucket in eu-west-1. Which solutions meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to create a public certificate in us-east-1. Use the certificate in CloudFront.
Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to create a public certificate in eu-west-1. Use the certificate in CloudFront.
Configure Amazon S3 to allow uploads from CloudFront. Configure S3 Transfer Acceleration.
Configure Amazon S3 to allow uploads through CloudFront origin access control (OAC).
Configure Amazon S3 to allow uploads from CloudFront. Configure an S3 website endpoint.

A company runs workloads on AWS and manages accounts with AWS Organizations. The company needs to identify which departments are responsible for specific costs. New accounts are continuously added to the organization. Its continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) framework already adds a populated department tag to AWS resources. The company wants AWS Cost Explorer reports showing service costs by department across all AWS accounts. Which combination of steps meets these requirements MOST operationally efficiently? (Choose two.)
Activate both the aws:createdBy and department cost allocation tags in the management account.
Create a new cost and usage report in Cost Explorer. Group by the department cost allocation tag. Apply filters to view all linked accounts and services.
Activate only the department cost allocation tag in the management account.
Create a new cost and usage report in Cost Explorer. Group by the department cost allocation tag without additional filters.
Activate only the aws:createdBy cost allocation tag in the management account.

A company creates a VPC with one public subnet and one private subnet and attaches an internet gateway to the VPC. An Application Load Balancer (ALB) in the public subnet communicates with Amazon EC2 instances in the private subnet. The private instances must download operating system (OS) and application updates from the internet but must not be accessible from the internet. Which combination of steps meets these requirements? (Choose three.)
Associate an Elastic IP address with the NAT gateway.
Add a 0.0.0.0/0 route to the private subnet route table with the NAT gateway as the target.
Deploy a NAT gateway in the public subnet.
Deploy a NAT gateway in the private subnet.
Add a 0.0.0.0/0 route to the public subnet route table with the NAT gateway as the target.
Associate an Elastic IP address with the internet gateway.
